cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.8)
project(tidybot_sim)

find_package(ament_cmake REQUIRED)

# Data only. worlds/ and maps/ are generated by scripts/gen_world.py from
# nav/scene.py; re-run it after editing the geometry, then rebuild.
install(PROGRAMS scripts/stop.sh scripts/mppi_controller.py scripts/benchmark.py scripts/send_goal.py
        DESTINATION lib/${PROJECT_NAME})
install(DIRECTORY urdf launch worlds maps config DESTINATION share/${PROJECT_NAME})

ament_package()
